an5.107:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an5.107:2.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti, samādhisampanno hoti, paññāsampanno hoti, vimuttisampanno hoti, vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno hoti.
an5.107:3.1: imehi kho bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
